About_HeaderSubtitle: Lightweight, modern Windows 11 theme switching utility
About_AppType: Native WinUI 3 / Windows App SDK 2.6 Desktop Application
About_DescContent: A modern, lightweight Windows 11 utility for instant switching between Light and Dark themes for applications and system surfaces. Supports custom tray icons, accidental-click cooldown, global keyboard shortcuts, and ultra-low background memory footprint.
About_LicenseContent: Free and Open Source under the MIT License.
